WITH sex_averages AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
      AND p.SEX <> ''
      AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT <> 0
    GROUP BY p.SEX
), first_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM sex_averages
), above_first AS (
    SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_ratio, f.mean_ratio AS first_mean
    FROM sex_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f
    WHERE s.avg_ratio > f.mean_ratio
), second_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM above_first
), remaining AS (
    SELECT a.avg_ratio, a.first_mean, m.mean_ratio AS second_mean
    FROM above_first AS a
    CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
    WHERE a.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_remaining_group_ratio_averages,
       AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;
